newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Western Australia dismiss NSW cheaply.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Western Australia dismiss NSW cheaply.

text.p: Western Australia were 31 for one at tea on the first day of their Sheffield Shield match on Thursday after dismissing New South Wales for a paltry 126.
Western Australian replacement bowler Matthew Garnaut and fast bowler Jo Angel both took for wickets for New South Wales to be all out an hour after lunch.
Angel finished with four for 20 after tearing thorugh the New South Wales top-order.
Dropped Australia opener Michael Slater started aggressively for New South Wales, making 25 before falling to Angel.
In Melbourne, former Test batsman David Boon spearheaded a Tasmanian recovery against Victoria to take his side to 161 for four at tea.
Tasmania had been reeling on 86 for four at lunch before Boon embarked on a cautious partnership with all-rounder Shaun Young. Boon was 49 not out at tea and Young unbeaten on 40.
